column3: “Put on royalty” is rendered “put on her royal robes.” “Before the house of the king” is rendered “in front of the king's rooms,” and “the house of royalty” as “the throne room.”
“What is to you” is rendered “What is troubling you.”
“To do the word of Esther” is rendered “that we may do as Esther desires.”
“At the feast of wine” is rendered “as they drank their wine at the banquet.”
“According to the word of the king” is rendered “as the king says.”
“Good of heart” is rendered “pleased of heart,” and “rage” as “anger.”
“Restrained himself” is rendered “controlled himself,” and “gathered” as “sent for.”
“All that the king had made him great” is rendered “every instance where the king had magnified him.”
“Is not adequate for me” is rendered “does not satisfy me.”
“Let people make a gallows” is rendered “Have a gallows … made”; NASB supplies “to have.” “The word was good before Haman” is rendered “the advice pleased Haman.”
